user.title: Ventilation Advisor
user.description: Shared settings for all rooms. Rooms can override most of them.

data_description.outdoor_temperature_sensor_entity: Optional. Used instead of the weather entity for outdoor temperature.
data_description.outdoor_humidity_sensor_entity: Optional. Used instead of the weather entity for outdoor humidity.
data_description.outdoor_weather_entity: Optional fallback for outdoor temperature and humidity when their sensors are not configured. A weather entity or outdoor temperature sensor is required.

comfort.name: Comfort window

data_description.comfort_lower_temperature: Must be below the upper temperature. A heating setpoint lifts the effective lower bound to max(lower comfort limit, setpoint).
data_description.comfort_upper_temperature: The effective upper bound is max(upper comfort limit, effective lower bound + 1 °C).
data_description.comfort_lower_humidity: Must be below the upper humidity. Indoor and outdoor humidity are judged at max(indoor temperature, heating setpoint).
data_description.comfort_upper_humidity: The humidity window is unchanged by heating. Fixed hysteresis is 0.5 °C / 3 %RH, capped at one quarter of each window's width.

comfort.description: Independent temperature and humidity comfort goals. Fixed hysteresis is 0.5 °C / 3 %RH, capped at one quarter of each window's width. An active heating setpoint adjusts the effective temperature window and humidity reference.

data_description.reference_airing_time: Recommended time at a 10 °C indoor/outdoor difference. Time scales with the square root of 10 divided by the temperature difference, clamped to the advanced limits. Increase for large rooms or small/tilted windows.
data_description.maximum_airing_time_factor: Maximum time = recommended time × this factor. Both times are fixed when opening is confirmed. Adverse-effect close suggestions never start before the maximum time.

overdue_airing.name: Overdue airing

data.overdue_airing_goal_reached_notify_durin: Notify goal reached during quiet hours

data_description.airing_interval: Time between required airings (minimum 1 hour, no maximum). The 48-hour default deliberately avoids frequent alerts for infrequently used rooms; decrease it for frequently used rooms. Repeat notifications use the separate Reminder interval.
data_description.overdue_airing_notify_during_quiet_hours: Allow this scenario's suggestions and reminders during quiet hours.
data_description.overdue_airing_reminder_interval: Delay between repeat notifications while airing is overdue; independent of how often airing is due. 0 disables reminders.
data_description.overdue_airing_goal_reached_notification: Requires this scenario's notifications. When all enabled opening goals are reached, you may close the window; airing longer is fine. Goals are independent of later adverse effects.
data_description.overdue_airing_goal_reached_notify_durin: Allow this scenario's goal-reached notifications and reminders during quiet hours.
data_description.overdue_airing_goal_reached_reminder_int: 0 disables reminders for this reached goal.

overdue_airing.description: Suggest opening when no qualifying airing has occurred within the airing interval. This sets how often airing is due; the reminder interval controls repeat notifications while it remains overdue.

heat_loss.name: Heat loss

data_description.heat_loss_notification_enabled: Suggest closing only after the maximum airing time, when outdoor air is adverse at a comfort-window edge.

data_description.heat_loss_reminder_factor: Repeat after this multiple of the opening's maximum airing time, subject to the advanced minimum safeguard reminder interval. 0 disables reminders.

heat_loss.description: After the maximum airing time, suggest closing if further airing risks cooling below the effective lower temperature bound.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Turn off to suppress advice notifications.
data_description.persistent_notifications_enabled: Show advice and problems as persistent notifications.
data_description.notify_actions: Modern notify entities (notify.send_message) are not supported. Replacing and clearing works only with Companion App devices or groups of them. Use the separate Home Assistant notifications option for persistent advice.
data_description.notify_update_on_reason_change: Phones may alert again on replacement.

data_description.quiet_hours_enabled: Defer all advice notifications, including adverse-effect close suggestions. Current advice is evaluated when quiet hours end.
data_description.quiet_hours_end: Equal start and end means no quiet hours.

data_description.reminders_enabled: Repeat a notification while the same advice remains relevant.

airing_time_advanced.name: Airing time – advanced

data_description.airing_time_lower_limit: Positive lower clamp; must not exceed the upper clamp.
data_description.airing_time_upper_limit: Positive upper clamp; also used when either temperature is missing.

airing_time_advanced.description: Recommended time = reference time × √(10 K / temperature difference), clamped to these limits. Maximum time = recommended time × maximum factor. At differences of 25/10/5/2/0 K, defaults give approximately 5.1/8/11.3/17.9/30 minutes recommended and 7.6/12/17/26.8/45 minutes maximum. Both are fixed at confirmed opening.

data_description.minimum_safeguard_reminder_interval: Minimum time between Heat loss, Heat gain, Moisture loss or Moisture gain reminders. The interval is the larger of this value and the scenario's factor × the opening's maximum airing time. A zero factor still disables reminders.
data_description.condition_delay: How long conditions must hold before an open suggestion.
data_description.goal_reached_delay: How long a comfort goal's reached condition must hold.
data_description.minimum_temperature_difference: Meaningful outdoor-air pull; released below half this difference.
data_description.minimum_humidity_difference: Meaningful outdoor-air pull at the heating-adjusted reference temperature; released below half this difference.
data_description.window_open_debounce: How long the room must stay open before the opening is confirmed.
data_description.window_close_debounce: How long the room must stay closed before the opening ends.
data_description.problem_report_delay: How long an input must be invalid before a Repairs issue is raised. Dependent scenarios freeze until recovery. 0 reports immediately.

first_room.title: Rooms
first_room.description: Add your first room now or later.

area.title: Room area
area.description: Choose an optional Home Assistant area before selecting the room's entities. Existing selections are kept even when outside the area.

data.filter_by_area: Only show entities in this area

data_description.area_id: Optional. Use the area's name unless you enter a name override on the next step.
data_description.filter_by_area: Turn off to select entities from other areas. Has no effect without an area. Applies only to this room's contacts, sensors and climate entity.

data_description.name: Optional when an area is selected: leave empty to use its name when saving. Required without an area. Used in notification titles.
data_description.advisor_enabled: Turn off to pause advice for this room; airing history is still tracked.
data_description.contacts: Binary sensors where on means open. The room counts as open when any contact is open.
data_description.indoor_temperature_entity: Required. Temperature sensor used for temperature advice and airing times.
data_description.indoor_humidity_entity: Optional. Needed for drying, humidifying, moisture-loss and moisture-gain advice.
data_description.thermostat_entity: Optional, heating-only. An active heating setpoint lifts the lower temperature bound to max(comfort lower, setpoint), and the upper bound to max(comfort upper, effective lower + 1 °C). For a range target, the lower end is used. Indoor and outdoor humidity are judged at max(indoor temperature, setpoint); the humidity window stays unchanged.

overrides.title: Room settings
overrides.description: Each option uses the shared value unless you choose a room value. Airing times are frozen during each opening.

airing_time_advanced.name: Airing time – advanced

data_description.airing_time_lower_limit: Positive lower clamp; must not exceed the upper clamp.
data_description.airing_time_upper_limit: Positive upper clamp; also used when either temperature is missing.

airing_time_advanced.description: Recommended time = reference time × √(10 K / temperature difference), clamped to these limits. Maximum time = recommended time × maximum factor. At differences of 25/10/5/2/0 K, defaults give approximately 5.1/8/11.3/17.9/30 minutes recommended and 7.6/12/17/26.8/45 minutes maximum. Both are fixed at confirmed opening.

data_description.minimum_safeguard_reminder_interval: Minimum time between Heat loss, Heat gain, Moisture loss or Moisture gain reminders. The interval is the larger of this value and the scenario's factor × the opening's maximum airing time. A zero factor still disables reminders.
data_description.condition_delay: How long conditions must hold before an open suggestion.
data_description.goal_reached_delay: How long a comfort goal's reached condition must hold.
data_description.minimum_temperature_difference: Meaningful outdoor-air pull; released below half this difference.
data_description.minimum_humidity_difference: Meaningful outdoor-air pull at the heating-adjusted reference temperature; released below half this difference.
data_description.window_open_debounce: How long the room must stay open before the opening is confirmed.
data_description.window_close_debounce: How long the room must stay closed before the opening ends.
data_description.problem_report_delay: How long an input must be invalid before a Repairs issue is raised. Dependent scenarios freeze until recovery. 0 reports immediately.

area.title: Room area

data.filter_by_area: Only show entities in this area

data_description.area_id: Optional. Use the area's name unless you enter a name override on the next step.
data_description.filter_by_area: Turn off to select entities from other areas. Has no effect without an area. Applies only to this room's contacts, sensors and climate entity.

data_description.name: Optional when an area is selected: leave empty to use its name when saving. Required without an area. Used in notification titles.
data_description.advisor_enabled: Turn off to pause advice for this room; airing history is still tracked.
data_description.contacts: Binary sensors where on means open. The room counts as open when any contact is open.
data_description.indoor_temperature_entity: Required. Temperature sensor used for temperature advice and airing times.
data_description.indoor_humidity_entity: Optional. Needed for drying, humidifying, moisture-loss and moisture-gain advice.
data_description.thermostat_entity: Optional, heating-only. An active heating setpoint lifts the lower temperature bound to max(comfort lower, setpoint), and the upper bound to max(comfort upper, effective lower + 1 °C). For a range target, the lower end is used. Indoor and outdoor humidity are judged at max(indoor temperature, setpoint); the humidity window stays unchanged.

overrides.title: Room settings
overrides.description: Each option uses the shared value unless you choose a room value. Airing times are frozen during each opening.

data_description.comfort_lower_temperature_mode: Must be below the upper temperature. A heating setpoint lifts the effective lower bound to max(lower comfort limit, setpoint).
data_description.comfort_lower_temperature: Must be below the upper temperature. A heating setpoint lifts the effective lower bound to max(lower comfort limit, setpoint).
data_description.comfort_upper_temperature_mode: The effective upper bound is max(upper comfort limit, effective lower bound + 1 °C).
data_description.comfort_upper_temperature: The effective upper bound is max(upper comfort limit, effective lower bound + 1 °C).
data_description.comfort_lower_humidity_mode: Must be below the upper humidity. Indoor and outdoor humidity are judged at max(indoor temperature, heating setpoint).
data_description.comfort_lower_humidity: Must be below the upper humidity. Indoor and outdoor humidity are judged at max(indoor temperature, heating setpoint).
data_description.comfort_upper_humidity_mode: The humidity window is unchanged by heating. Fixed hysteresis is 0.5 °C / 3 %RH, capped at one quarter of each window's width.
data_description.comfort_upper_humidity: The humidity window is unchanged by heating. Fixed hysteresis is 0.5 °C / 3 %RH, capped at one quarter of each window's width.

data_description.reference_airing_time_mode: Recommended time at a 10 °C indoor/outdoor difference. Time scales with the square root of 10 divided by the temperature difference, clamped to the advanced limits. Increase for large rooms or small/tilted windows.
data_description.reference_airing_time: Recommended time at a 10 °C indoor/outdoor difference. Time scales with the square root of 10 divided by the temperature difference, clamped to the advanced limits. Increase for large rooms or small/tilted windows.
data_description.maximum_airing_time_factor_mode: Maximum time = recommended time × this factor. Both times are fixed when opening is confirmed. Adverse-effect close suggestions never start before the maximum time.
data_description.maximum_airing_time_factor: Maximum time = recommended time × this factor. Both times are fixed when opening is confirmed. Adverse-effect close suggestions never start before the maximum time.
